title: Jersey in 3 Days: Castles, Tides, and Durrell’s Zoo
subtitle: Explore Jersey in 3 days, from Elizabeth Castle to Mont Orgueil, then from the War Tunnels to La Corbière Lighthouse.
climate: Aim for May through September: at Jersey Airport, average highs are around 20 °C in July and August, with more than 230 hours of sunshine per month. In January, they drop to around 8 °C and rainfall exceeds 90 mm; Elizabeth Castle is closed in winter, and several attractions have reduced hours. Pack a windbreaker in any season for the northern and western headlands.
